Our work includes labor investigations, worker support, research, public advocacy, and engagement with governments, media, and other stakeholders. CLW is a small, fast-moving team with projects across multiple countries and regions. The work in this role is varied, and it calls for someone who can work independently, communicate clearly, and follow through. This role suits someone organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, who can keep several things moving at once. Because CLW is a small team, this position covers a wide range of work — but the day-to-day volume in any one area is usually manageable. What matters most to us is that you can move between different kinds of tasks as the need arises, judge what comes first, and make sure the important things actually get done. What you'll get out of it Work at the center of what we do. You'll help move forward CLW's investigations and advocacy across several countries, working with research reports, media outreach, and policy advocacy — not just administrative tasks. Build international experience quickly. CLW's projects involve working with U.S. and EU government bodies, UN agencies, multinational companies, international organizations, and the press. You'll take part in that work directly and build real experience in cross-border projects and international communication. Learn up close. Meetings and materials Coordinate internal and external meetings, including scheduling, invitations, and materials Help prepare agendas, background materials, briefings, and presentations Attend meetings, take minutes, and track follow-up items Organize and maintain records of key meetings, events, and trips 5. Office operations and administration Help manage the office budget, expenses, invoices, and staff reimbursements, and handle routine purchasing Build and maintain electronic filing and internal document systems Support recruitment, onboarding, and related administrative work Help coordinate interns and volunteers Take on other responsibilities as assigned by the Executive Director Hours and Schedule This role follows the organization's regular office hours. All scheduling follows organizational policy and applicable law.
